```{r}
#| label: landing-umap
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

set.seed(2026)

celltypes <- c("CD14 Mono", "CD16 Mono", "B", "CD4 T", "CD8 T", "NK", "DC", "Platelet")
centers <- tibble(
  ct = celltypes,
  cx = c(-4.5, -4.0, 3.5, 4.0,  1.0, -1.5, -3.0, 4.5),
  cy = c( 2.5, -1.5, 3.0, -2.5, -3.5, 4.5,  -1.0, 0.5)
)
n_per <- c(420, 220, 380, 520, 360, 240, 140, 90)

cells <- map2_dfr(centers$ct, n_per, function(ct, n) {
  c <- centers |> filter(ct == !!ct)
  tibble(
    ct = ct,
    u1 = c$cx + rnorm(n, 0, 0.55),
    u2 = c$cy + rnorm(n, 0, 0.55)
  )
})

ggplot(cells, aes(u1, u2, color = ct)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 0.9) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

Welcome to the **Center for Biomedical Data Science Single Cell RNA-seq Analysis Workshop**. This is a hands-on, three-day workshop that takes you end-to-end through a modern single-cell RNA-seq analysis: from count matrices through quality control, clustering, cell-type annotation, multi-sample integration, and differential expression. By the end you'll be able to produce and interpret a figure like the clustered UMAP above. 

The workshop is **sponsored by the [Center for Biomedical Data Science (CBDS)](https://knightcampus.uoregon.edu/cbds) in the Knight Campus at the University of Oregon.**

This site hosts everything the workshop runs on — lecture slides, hands-on tutorials, datasets, and reference material — and it stays online as a resource for your continued learning long after the workshop ends.

Use the navigation bar above to reach the schedule, software setup, all workshop **materials**, and additional resources.
